name: Funshine Culture Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Funshine Culture Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the design and production services for cultural and artistic performances in China. The company offers creative planning, visual design, and on-site execution services for cultural performances; and creative, design, and production services for cultural tourism performances, such as live-action tourism performances, theme park tourism performances, and theater performances. It also provides creative planning, artistic design, and production services for various landscape lighting performance projects, including art lighting, dynamic light shows, and light projection shows; and design and production services for virtual performance products.
